A '''painting''' depicted an artist's photo-realistic [[Painting/Legends|rendition]] of a [[Star/Legends|star]] emerging from behind a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], executed in a palette of [[Color/Legends|blues]]. The work was unique and no longer in circulation at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when its only copy was owned by [[Sean Trenwell]]. He awarded the painting to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who assisted him during his [[Time/Legends|time]] as the [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
This painting appears in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It is a reward from a quest tasked to the player by Sean Trenwell after Trenwell has won the Bestine mayoral election. In the game, it is named only ''A Painting'' and can be used in the player character's home as decoration. Although the game suggests the painting is one of a kind, multiple players may own copies of it.<ref name="SWG" />
